from shopkit.api.handlers import handle
from shopkit.errors import InsufficientStock
from shopkit.inventory.stock import Stock


def test_reserve_success():
    stock = Stock()
    stock.receive("sku-a", 5)
    stock.reserve("sku-a", 2)
    assert stock.available("sku-a") == 3
    stock.reserve("sku-a", 3)
    assert stock.available("sku-a") == 0


def test_reserve_insufficient_leaves_stock_unchanged():
    stock = Stock()
    stock.receive("sku-a", 2)
    with pytest.raises(InsufficientStock):
        stock.reserve("sku-a", 3)
    assert stock.available("sku-a") == 2


def test_reserve_insufficient_via_api():
    stock = Stock()
    stock.receive("sku-a", 2)
    status, body = handle(stock.reserve, "sku-a", 3)
    assert status == 409
    assert body["error"] == "InsufficientStock"
    assert body["requested"] == 3
    assert body["available"] == 2


def test_reserve_unknown_sku_fails():
    stock = Stock()
    status, body = handle(stock.reserve, "sku-missing", 1)
    assert status == 409
    assert body["requested"] == 1
    assert body["available"] == 0
    assert stock.available("sku-missing") == 0
